messages.content: Write ONLY one Python function toposort(nodes: list[int], edges: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> list[int]. Return the lexicographically smallest topological ordering of the directed graph. Every endpoint is in nodes, nodes are unique, duplicate edges count once. Empty input returns []. Raise ValueError for a cycle, including a self-loop. Do not mutate the inputs. Use only builtins: no imports, helpers, classes, decorators, or I/O. Return the complete function in one fenced Python block.
